name: eng-project-governance
summary: Owns canonical work-item, milestone, candidate, release-window, pipeline-gate, project remote-sync, and closure decisions.
input_contract: Facts required by the chosen project action: request and decision sources; canonical binding and expected revision for task writes; candidate, target and authority for selection or remote-sync intent.
output_contract: Actual project decision, relevant references and evidence, affected blockers; optional version 2 project slice identified by decision_ref without mandatory release or architecture fields.
